goal: 向中介说清需求并约好看房

n1.speaker: 中介 Agent
n1.line: Welcome to Sunshine Realty! What kind of apartment are you looking for?
n1.lineCn: 欢迎来到阳光房产!您想找什么样的公寓?

grammar.name: 定语从句的引出
grammar.note: 回答时用定语从句修饰 apartment,如 an apartment that has...。

options.text: I am looking for an apartment that has two bedrooms and a small balcony.
options.textCn: 我在找一套有两间卧室和一个小阳台的公寓。
options.feedback: 用 that 引导定语从句具体描述需求,非常清楚。
"好"太模糊,中介完全无从下手。
答非所问,和租房毫无关系。

n2.speaker: 中介 Agent
n2.line: Great! We have several apartments that match your needs. Do you prefer a place near the subway or one that is close to your work?
n2.lineCn: 太好了!我们有好几套符合您需求的房子。您更倾向靠近地铁的,还是离公司近的?

grammar.name: one that is close to...
grammar.note: one 代替 apartment,后面接 that 引导的定语从句进行限定。

options.text: I prefer the one that is near the subway, because I often travel around the city.
options.textCn: 我更喜欢靠近地铁的那套,因为我经常在城里跑。
options.feedback: 用定语从句精确表达偏好,还说明了原因。
没有明确偏好,中介难以推荐。

n3.speaker: 中介 Agent
n3.line: Let me make it easier. Is there anything special that you really care about, like the view, the floor, or the furniture?
n3.lineCn: 让我换个问法。有没有什么您特别在意的,比如景观、楼层或家具?

grammar.name: anything that you care about
grammar.note: anything 后用 that 引导定语从句,说明"你在乎的"。

options.text: Yes. I want an apartment whose floor is above the 10th, and one that faces south for the sunlight.
options.textCn: 有。我想要楼层在十楼以上、朝南能晒到太阳的公寓。
options.feedback: 用 whose 和 that 两个定语从句补充细节,需求具体。

options.text: I do not know what I want. You decide for me.
options.textCn: 我不知道我要什么,你替我做主吧。
options.feedback: 把需求全推给中介,很难找到合适房源。

n4.speaker: 中介 Agent
n4.line: Here is one that might be perfect for you: a 70-square-meter apartment on the 15th floor, whose balcony faces the river.
n4.lineCn: 这儿有一套可能非常适合您:15 层 70 平米,阳台朝河。

grammar.name: whose 引导定语从句
grammar.note: whose balcony faces... 用 whose 表示"它的阳台",修饰公寓。

options.text: It sounds nice! How much is the rent for the apartment that has the river view?
options.textCn: 听起来不错!那套有河景的公寓租金是多少?
options.feedback: 用定语从句准确指代房源,还问了关键价格。

options.text: Show me everything at once, I cannot decide.
options.textCn: 一次全给我看吧,我做不了决定。
options.feedback: 信息过载,谈判效率很低。

n5.speaker: 中介 Agent
n5.line: Sure. We have three apartments that you can see today. Which one interests you the most?
n5.lineCn: 好的。我们今天有三套房可以看。您对哪一套最感兴趣?

grammar.name: apartments that you can see
grammar.note: that you can see 作定语从句,修饰 apartments,说明"可看的"。

options.text: The one that is near the subway and has a balcony is the best for me. Let me see it first.
options.textCn: 靠近地铁又有阳台的那套最适合我,先看它吧。
options.feedback: 明确选中目标房源,推动看房安排。

options.text: All of them. I will visit every one of them next month.
options.textCn: 全都感兴趣,我下个月再全看。
options.feedback: 拖延到下个月,中介难以安排。

n6.speaker: 中介 Agent
n6.line: The rent is 2,800 yuan a month for the one that faces the river. When would you like to visit it?
n6.lineCn: 朝河那套月租 2800 元。您想什么时候去看房呢?

grammar.name: the one that faces the river
grammar.note: that faces the river 限定修饰 one,避免与其它房源混淆。

options.text: I am free this Saturday morning. Can we meet at 10 o'clock in front of the building?
options.textCn: 我周六上午有空。我们可以 10 点在大楼前碰面吗?
options.feedback: 明确时间地点,看房约定顺利达成。

options.text: I will call you when I am free. Maybe someday.
options.textCn: 我有空再打给你,也许某天吧。
options.feedback: 含糊其辞,看房遥遥无期。

success.speaker: 中介 Agent
success.line: Perfect! I will book it for 10 a.m. this Saturday. See you then!
success.lineCn: 完美!我就订周六上午十点。到时候见!

fail1.speaker: 中介 Agent
fail1.line: I am sorry, but without a clear requirement I cannot find the right apartment for you. Come back when you know what you want.
fail1.lineCn: 抱歉,没有明确需求我很难帮您找到合适的房子。想清楚了再来吧。

fail2.speaker: 中介 Agent
fail2.line: No problem. Take your time. Feel free to contact me whenever you are ready.
fail2.lineCn: 没问题。您慢慢考虑,随时联系我。
